metadata.case_name: YUEN PUI MAN ELLEN v. MAJESTIC FURNITURE & INTERIOR DESIGN LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: Full-time course instructor teaching arts in tertiary institutions

injuries.description: allergic symptoms in the eyes, throat, nose, lung and skin which persisted up to June 2009 and which has since recurred intermittently when she is exposed to odours from substances such as fresh paints, certain perfumes and shampoos.
injuries.body_part: eyes, throat, nose, lung and skin
source: Ellen has as a result suffered personal injury in that she had allergic symptoms in the eyes, throat, nose, lung and skin which persisted up to June 2009 and which has since recurred intermittently when she is exposed to odours from substances such as fresh paints, certain perfumes and shampoos.

manifestations.description: allergic symptoms in the eyes, throat, nose, lung and skin

intolerance to offensive odour and environment of a poor quality; uncomfortable whenever she smells strong or chemical-like odour including smell from fragrance, shampoos, detergent, bathing soap and cigarette smoke
depressive mood and a lack of interest in previous hobbies
daily activities at her residence including dining, reading, resting and other leisure activities were seriously affected
cannot withstand strong or chemical-like odour at workplace and cannot take up as many teaching tasks as before or resume full-time working other than working as a part-time tutor

treatments_received: EMD (Environmental Management Division) indoor air quality tests (27 October 2008; 20 February 2009; 7 March 2009)
inspection and testing by Professor Christopher Y.H. Chao (2 May 2014 and 2 May 2015)

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Daily activities at her residence including dining, reading, resting and other leisure activities were seriously affected during the period of symptoms.
She cannot take up as many teaching tasks as before or resume full-time working other than working as a part-time tutor.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She has displayed a depressive mood and a lack of interest in previous hobbies.

comparable_cases.case_name: Andrew William Maxwell v Keliston Marine (Far East) Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: The plaintiff developed asthma due to exposure to a certain substance used for repair works inside tunnels between September 2000 and February 2001; he developed persistent cough, dry and worse at night and in early morning, with audible wheeze and chest tightness and continued to have intermittent symptoms and became short of breath easily on walking and swimming and had to give up sports altogether.
